---
title: "Discussion - Week 08"
---

*Instructions: In groups of two or three students, solve the following problems. Your TA will answer questions and provide hints, but won't solve the problem for you. Each student should submit a hard copy of their work to the TA at the end of the discussion.*

::: {.callout-warning title="Problem 1"}
Draw both a pmf and cdf of the random variable $X\sim \text{Bern}(0.6)$.
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Problem 2"}
What is the median of the following two random variables?

a. $X\sim \text{Bern}(0.6)$.
b. $X\sim \text{Bern}(0.3)$.
:::
